home.title: NextTools - Developer's Toolbox
home.description: All-in-one developer tools platform integrating Redis, Kafka, Postman, ZooKeeper, and SSH clients
home.subtitle: Integrates Redis, Kafka, HTTP, ZooKeeper, SSH, ElasticSearch, and Database clients, making development and debugging simple and efficient
home.featuresDesc: NextTools provides intuitive interfaces and rich features to help developers improve productivity

redis.name: Redis Client
redis.description: High-performance Redis database management tool supporting data visualization, real-time monitoring, and batch operations

kafka.name: Kafka Client
kafka.description: Enterprise-grade messaging queue management tool supporting topic monitoring, producer simulation, and real-time consumer tracking

http.name: HTTP Client
http.description: Full-featured API testing and debugging tool supporting multi-protocol requests, environment variables, and collection management

zookeeper.name: ZooKeeper Client
zookeeper.description: Distributed coordination service management tool supporting node tree preview, monitoring, and cluster configuration management

ssh.name: SSH Client
ssh.description: Professional remote server connection tool integrating high-performance terminal, SFTP file management, and session persistence

elastic.name: ElasticSearch Client
elastic.description: Integrated search engine console providing index visualization, document query, and cluster health metrics monitoring

database.name: Database Client
database.description: Unified database management entry supporting deep MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite structured management

integratedPlatform.title: Integrated Platform
integratedPlatform.description: Integrates various development tools in one place, eliminating the need to switch between multiple applications, improving work efficiency

secure.title: Secure & Reliable
secure.description: Uses encrypted storage mechanisms to protect sensitive information and ensure connection security

sync.title: Real-time Sync
sync.description: Automatically stores recent connection information, supports cross-devices, work anywhere anytime

visualization.title: Data Visualization
visualization.description: Intuitively displays data and connection status, helping quickly locate and resolve issues

custom.title: Custom Scripts
custom.description: Supports custom scripts and quick operations to meet personalized needs

support.title: Technical Support
support.description: Professional team provides technical support and assistance to ensure stable and reliable tools

footer.description: Developer's toolbox, integrating various debugging tools to make development more efficient
